name: Woodcock Nature Center Summer Nature Camp
description_short: A weekday nature day camp (9:30 am to 3 pm) on a 150-acre preserve in Wilton, CT, for children entering PreK through 8th grade. Environmental educators lead animal encounters, nature crafts, hiking, boating on the pond and wilderness skills.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp page mentions kayaking on the center's pond; the program pages mention canoeing on the pond and wading in streams and wetlands. No swimming is mentioned, and no supervision or swim test details are given.

warnings: The page shows the 2026 season (June 15 - August 14, 2026), which has already ended as of 2026-10-13. No 2027 dates or details are posted.
The page says camp runs June 15 - August 14 with weekly registration but does not list each week's dates. The sessions above give the season span for each age group, not separate weeks.
For 2026, each camper could register for at most 2 weeks, with a waitlist for more. This may change for 2027.
Groups go by the grade the child enters in the fall. The youngest group is PreK, so grade_min is left blank.
unknowns: 2027 season dates and weekly session dates
Whether a deposit is required, and the refund policy
Age ranges in years (the page uses grades only)
Whether before-care or after-care is offered
Whether lunch is provided (the page suggests campers bring their own)
When 2027 registration opens and whether spots are available

changes: Replaced the three season-long sessions with one session per bookable week and group for 2026 (30 in all), from the Programs page: Fledglings and Scouts/Rangers every week June 15 to August 14, Explorers from June 22, Uncharted only June 22, July 6, July 20 and July 27 weeks.
Added weekly prices from the Programs page: Fledglings $555, Scouts, Rangers and Explorers $530, Uncharted $570; price_min 530, price_max 570, price_per_week 530.
The 4-day week of June 29 to July 2 has no price shown, so its price is left blank.
Added age_min 4 (Fledglings must turn four by the start of their camp week).
Added the email wnc@woodcocknaturecenter.org from the camp page.
Set meals_included to false: campers bring their own nut-free lunch and snack.
Added the outdoor category and corrected the waterfront note: the program pages say canoeing as well as kayaking; the description now says boating.
Season stays 2026; 2027 dates are not posted yet.
